briefdescription.para: Helper function for finding a block which should have a value for the given user.

detaileddescription.para: For PHI-nodes this block is the corresponding predecessor, for other instructions it's their parent block.

memberdef.argsstring: (const SmallPtrSetImpl< BasicBlock * > &UsingBlocks, const SmallPtrSetImpl< BasicBlock * > &DefBlocks, SmallPtrSetImpl< BasicBlock * > &LiveInBlocks, PredIteratorCache &PredCache)
memberdef.name: ComputeLiveInBlocks

briefdescription.para: Given sets of UsingBlocks and DefBlocks, compute the set of LiveInBlocks.

detaileddescription.para: This is basically a subgraph limited by DefBlocks and UsingBlocks.
